title: agent-stage spec
description: Declarative 3D/2D animation spec for agent-stage (three.js + GSAP).

fog.description: Fog requires color, near and far together.

duration.description: Scale the whole score to fit exactly this duration (seconds).

position.description: Array of exactly 3 finite numbers [x, y, z].

lookAt.description: Array of exactly 3 finite numbers [x, y, z].

display.description: How the canvas is mounted and fitted.

overlay.description: Deprecated alias for svg; cannot be combined with svg.

fit.description: How the layer matches the canvas; default 'cover'.

id.description: Unique DOM id for the text group.

vec3.description: Array of exactly 3 finite numbers [x, y, z].

material.description: Object material. emissive is only valid for the neon preset.

map.description: Texture image URL (http(s):// or data:image/); applied in DOM/WebGL environments, ignored headless with a warning.

light.description: Scene light. target is only valid for directional and spot lights.

position.description: Array of exactly 3 finite numbers [x, y, z].

target.description: Array of exactly 3 finite numbers [x, y, z].

objectDef.description: 3D object. params keys are gated per object type.

parent.description: Name of another object in the spec to parent to; no cycles or self-reference.

material.description: Object material. emissive is only valid for the neon preset.

map.description: Texture image URL (http(s):// or data:image/); applied in DOM/WebGL environments, ignored headless with a warning.

position.description: Array of exactly 3 finite numbers [x, y, z].

anyOf.description: Array of exactly 3 finite numbers [x, y, z].

params.description: Type-specific numbers; keys per object type.
Geometry params for box (all optional, numbers).
Geometry params for sphere (all optional, numbers).
Geometry params for icosahedron (all optional, numbers).
Geometry params for dodecahedron (all optional, numbers).
Geometry params for torus (all optional, numbers).
Geometry params for torusKnot (all optional, numbers).
Geometry params for cone (all optional, numbers).
Geometry params for cylinder (all optional, numbers).
Geometry params for plane (all optional, numbers).
Geometry params for ring (all optional, numbers).

score.description: Flat array of animation cues, sequenced via id/after/alongside/offset.

do.description: Animation verb or intent preset name.

to.description: Object/light name, camera, scene, DOM selector, or array of names (staggered).

id.description: Unique cue id, addressable by after/alongside.

after.description: Start when the referenced cue ends; mutually exclusive with at.

alongside.description: Start when the referenced cue starts; mutually exclusive with at.

offset.description: Seconds added to the resolved start; default 0.

stagger.description: Stagger in seconds when to is an array.

repeat.description: Repeats; -1 or values above the cap are clamped.

from.description: animate only: starting bridge-prop values before the tween.

center.description: Array of exactly 3 finite numbers [x, y, z].

from.description: Start angle in radians; default atan2 of camera position vs center.

radius.description: Circle radius; default distance from camera to center.

with.description: Camera orbit around center in the XZ plane.

center.description: Array of exactly 3 finite numbers [x, y, z].

with.description: Camera dolly along the direction from center to the camera.

items.description: Array of exactly 3 finite numbers [x, y, z].

smooth.description: Catmull-Rom smoothing when >= 3 points; default true.

closed.description: Close the curve back to the first point; default false.

orient.description: Look along the path direction while moving; default false.

center.description: Array of exactly 3 finite numbers [x, y, z].

svg.description: 2D SVG overlay layer. "overlay" is accepted as an alias at the spec root.

fit.description: How the layer matches the canvas; default 'cover'.

id.description: Unique DOM id for the text group.

svgShape.description: SVG shape. Geometry keys are gated per type; group children may nest (limited to 8 levels).

id.description: Unique DOM id for the shape element.
